llm.summary: The skill’s code-free instructions, requested credential, and behavior are consistent with its stated purpose of calling the 0xArchive API for historical crypto market data.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the runtime instructions. The only declared credential is OXARCHIVE_API_KEY which is exactly what an API-wrapping skill would need. No unrelated binaries or credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains concrete curl examples, endpoint lists, and timestamp helpers. Instructions only reference the declared env var ($OXARCHIVE_API_KEY) and standard shell commands (date, curl). There are no directives to read arbitrary files, other env vars, or to transmit data to endpoints outside api.0xarchive.io.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — nothing is written to disk or downloaded during install. This is lowest-risk for install behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single API key (OXARCHIVE_API_KEY) is required and it is declared as the primary credential. The requested environment access is proportional to the described purpose. Note: some API endpoints allow querying by user address (liquidations/user/{address}), so API usage could expose address-linked activity if such queries are made.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill does not request always:true, does not install persistent components, and does not modify other skills or system config. Model-invocation not disabled is the normal default.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: The skill is internally consistent and appears to be a thin wrapper around the 0xArchive REST API. Before installing: only provide an OXARCHIVE_API_KEY you trust (prefer a key with limited scope/permissions and rate limits), rotate or revoke the key if compromised, and monitor API usage for unexpected queries. Be aware some endpoints can return events tied to specific addresses (liquidations/user/{address}); avoid supplying personally identifying addresses unless you intend that data to be queried. Finally, note the skill source/homepage is unknown — if you require stronger assurance, ask the publisher for provenance or prefer an official integration from 0xArchive.
